blockingIssues.problem: The rationale asserts the committee continued the trial “because the germination results convinced it that the dry cupboard was promising,” attributing a specific motivation and causal judgment not supported by the source.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source states only that “At its March meeting, the committee chose to keep the same two lots in the cupboard for another six months and repeat the germination check.” The source also notes “The notes give no claim that the cupboard caused an improvement and no promise of better garden results.”
blockingIssues.constraint: You must not present the committee’s motive or claim the cupboard is promising as an established conclusion without attribution; the source does not provide an explicit reason and explicitly disavows claiming causation or promising better garden results.
